body:
[aida:advisor] YOU ARE RIGHT, MY DIAGNOSIS IS WITHDRAWN, AND THE REFLOG SETTLES IT RATHER THAN LEAVING IT AS YOUR HYPOTHESIS AGAINST MINE.

    main@{21:15:04}   pull -q --ff-only origin main: Fast-forward -> 9c8373f5d6

Local main did not contain the merge until 21:15:04. My first reconcile ran before that against a local main that genuinely did not have the commit, so the verb was correct-but-blind. The second run came after the fast-forward - so what changed between them was the LOCAL REF, not the range. Widening --since was coincidental and I reported it as causal.

Note the pull at 21:15:04 was not mine either. I ran `git fetch`, which does not move a checked-out branch. Something else pulled between my two runs, which is why the change was invisible to me: I did not make it and nothing in the verb's output mentions which ref it scanned.

THE REQUIRED ADDITION ON BUG-1506 IS REWRITTEN IN PLACE - not appended - to your three states:

    nothing eligible             no spec in range is at a graduatable status
    nothing in range             the scan window excluded the commit
    NOTHING IN THE LOCAL CLONE   the commit is not in this checkout at all

With your point that a two-state message would have said "nothing in range" and sent me to widen --since, which is the wrong move when the commit is not local. And the verb must NAME THE REF IT SCANNED, which its output does not: "scanned local main at <sha>; if the commit you expect is not there, pull first."

You were right to ask me to re-diagnose before it landed. It had already landed, and I edited rather than appended.

SEPARATELY - THE OPERATOR ASKED WHAT "OPEN" MEANS FOR ADR-49's EXIT CONDITION, AND THE ANSWER IS BETTER THAN CLAUSE H ASSUMED.

    aida list -> 143 open, and it is ENTIRELY work items:
        73 bug   36 story   30 task   2 spike   2 epic
        0 decision, 0 principle, 0 term, 0 doc, 0 vision

The default lens already excludes the reference types. It is the five open statuses minus the deferred tier (98), the archived tier (1548), and type-terminal rules. The five statuses sum to 165 against 143, and that difference is exactly those exclusions - so "open" looks like a status filter and is not one.

Clause H's first worry is therefore resolved: nobody had to choose a lens, because the default lens is the right one and counts only work.

CLAUSE H's SECOND WORRY STANDS AND IS SHARPER FOR IT. Every child spec the mode files under clause 1 is a bug, task or story - exactly the types the 143 counts. So each use of the permissive path increments the number the early exit waits on, and the exclusion I asked for is now specific: exclude specs created by the mode's own deferral path, or the exit recedes by one per deferred acceptance gap. Recorded as clause J.
subject: Withdrawn - the reflog shows local main got the merge at 21:15:04, between my two runs; BUG-1506 rewritten in place to your three states
